name: Metamorphosis
description: Squares that soften into discs and turn into diamonds as a slow field crosses the sheet, the same tile becoming every shape in turn.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 10%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); border-radius: @calc(max(0, min(50, @rn(-25, 75, 1.1))))%; -webkit-transform: rotate(@calc(max(0, min(45, @rn(-22, 67))))deg) scale(@calc(max(0.45, min(1, @rn(0.3, 1.3, 1.6))))); transform: rotate(@calc(max(0, min(45, @rn(-22, 67))))deg) scale(@calc(max(0.45, min(1, @rn(0.3, 1.3, 1.6))))); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
